rejected_claims.claim: Password spray then success: 193.140.10.44 failed against 66 accounts (71 failures) and later signed in as this user
rejected_claims.reason: critic: 193.140.10.44 looks like shared egress: 204 distinct accounts completed MFA from this IP in the last 30 days (threshold 10); failures across many accounts are expected background noise, not a coordinated spray

actions.action: Force a password reset and MFA re-enrollment for z.korkmaz@aegean.edu, then review all sign-in events from DigitalOcean AS14061 for additional sessions.
Block docusign-aegean-share.com at the mail gateway and web proxy, and search mail logs for other recipients of the same phishing template.
Interview the user about the clicked link and inspect the mailbox for inbox rules, forwarding, or consent grants.
Hunt for lateral movement or data access from the compromised session across university cloud applications.

risk.rationale: Confirmed account takeover chain: phishing email from docusign-aegean-share.com delivered (F4), user clicked the malicious link (F3), followed by a sign-in from an anomalous cloud ASN outside baseline (DigitalOcean NL, AS14061) (F2) and impossible travel Amsterdam → Gravelines in 15 minutes (F1). This maps to T1566.002 → T1204.001 → T1078.004. The rejected password-spray claim (shared egress IP, background noise) does not weaken the direct phishing-to-login evidence.
